title: Plannotation index 0.1
description: Document-level index of the plannotated pages in one PDF. Embedded once per document as plannotation-index.json so that a reader can see what is plannotated, and at which conformance level, without opening every page attachment. This schema is deliberately self-contained: a third-party reader must be able to validate an index without also fetching the plannotation schema.

provenance.description: aggregate over every page in the document

model.description: the source model the plannotations were written from, if there was one

pages.description: one entry per plannotated page; unplannotated pages are simply absent

sheetId.description: sheet number as printed, e.g. TWP-101

level.description: conformance level this page's plannotation reaches

file.description: name of the embedded plannotation file, e.g. plannotation-p0000.json

extensions.description: namespaced extras; never required by readers
